Last night I made these cookies... And oh my goodness... Such a perfect and quick recipe..... I loved how cookies turned out and they were delicious and best recipe I ever tried...

This is their recipe which is behind the packet.  
2 1/4 cup flour 
1 tsp  baking soda 
1/2 tsp salt 
1 cup butter softened 
3/4 granulated sugar 
3/4 cup brown sugar 
2 eggs 
2 tsp vanilla 
1 bag Ghirardelli semi sweet chocolate chips .

Please do not follow that recipe.  If you do your cookies will turn out so bad.  I had to start all over and followed the recipe from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uJwekkbGPns&ab_channel=OhYumwithAnnaOlson  My cookies were soooo good after I followed her recipe.
